# gns3_project (Data Source)

Looks up an existing GNS3 project by name, opened or closed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Looks up a project that already exists on the server.
data "gns3_project" "lab" {
  name = "lab"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name.

### Read-Only

- `filename` (String) Project file name.
- `path` (String) Project directory on the server.
- `project_id` (String) Project UUID.
- `status` (String) `opened` or `closed`.
